decisions.reason: Saturating memory has the lowest leave-trajectory-out error by a substantial margin, while slow_wave has the greatest prediction disagreement among the informative candidates.
decisions.prediction: Under slow_wave, output will lag the input and show a smaller response at larger accumulated-history magnitudes than a linear-memory model predicts.

decisions.reason: Saturating memory has the best trajectory-level validation error, but residual lag correlation remains and PRBS has the largest disagreement among available experiments, making it a useful probe before final selection.
decisions.prediction: Under PRBS, saturating memory will predict bounded history-dependent responses; sustained reversals may reveal systematic lag errors and larger errors than its validation score suggests.

decisions.reason: History_all has the lowest leave-trajectory-out error, narrowly beating saturating_memory; the improvement is modest, and residual lag correlation remains substantial.
decisions.prediction: Rapid reversals will expose lag-related errors; history_all should better track their timing than a model using only saturating accumulated history.
